name: prostarm-stock-portal
description: Branch inward/outward stock management portal for Prostarm Info Systems Ltd. Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no runtime dependencies.

scripts.check: node --check js/api.js && node --check js/auth.js && node --check js/ui.js && node --check js/stock-core.js && node --check js/dashboard.js && node --check js/summary.js && node --check js/reports.js && node --check js/admin.js

author: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd.
//: There are no dependencies by design. The portal is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, so it runs from a double-clicked index.html with no build step and no internet connection. npm start only serves the folder over HTTP.
